nt-shear-srgm-h.name: SRGM-H light type mechanical guillotine shears, 1/8″ × 3.6 ft – 10 ft
nt-shear-srgm-h.summary: The light-type direct-gear guillotine for sheet-metal shops, HVAC and signage: 1/8″ (3 mm) mild steel over 43″ to 10 ft in 35 strokes a minute from a 4 to 10 HP motor, with a manual back gauge, squaring arm, front holding arms and photocell rear guard as standard. The same welded frame, teflon slideways and four-edged blades as the SRGM, in a lighter machine from 2,425 lb. An NC back gauge, pneumatic sheet support and a touch-screen control are options.

Welded steel frame, cutting beam in teflon slideways, blade gap set from the front, mechanical hold-downs and an NC back gauge with 29.5″ stroke, squaring arm, ball-transfer table, shadow-line light and photocell rear guard as standard.

dn-bs.name: BS / BSY hydraulic swing beam shears, 1/4″ – 5/8″ × 6.8 – 13.5 ft
dn-bs.summary: The hydraulic shear for plate from 1/4″ to 5/8″: a swing beam on two cylinders cuts the full length in one stroke, 8 to 22 strokes a minute, with an NC back gauge, hydraulic hold-downs and a welded frame that thousands of shops run every day. The light BSY 2006 – 3006 cut 1/4″ over 6.8 – 10 ft; the BS 3006 – 4016 go to 5/8″ (16 mm) mild steel over 10 and 13.5 ft. Single-point blade-gap adjustment, sheet slider table and squaring arm are standard.

dn-das.name: DAS CNC hydraulic guillotine shears, 1/4″ – 3/4″ × 10 – 20 ft
dn-das.summary: The production shear: a guillotine beam on linear rollers with a variable cutting angle, so thin sheet is cut fast and flat at 0.5° and 3/4″ plate at 3° with less distortion. The ESA 630 CNC sets back gauge, blade gap and angle from the thickness and material the operator keys in; 16 – 33 hydraulic hold-downs, a 1 m ball-screw back gauge and the front photocell guard are standard. Thirteen models: 1/4″ to 3/4″ (6 – 20 mm) mild steel over 10, 13 and 20 ft, from 8,000 to 55,000 kg.
